name: Sandforge
description: Sandbox templates with a trust envelope, validated and booted in E2B.

skills.name: template-validate
skills.description: Check templates against the schema and trust rules before a commit, or check a folder of your own templates.

skills.name: template-scaffold
skills.description: Add a template for a runtime that starts from the strictest trust envelope and passes the validator.

skills.name: sandbox-boot
skills.description: Boot an e2b template in a live E2B microVM, read the probes, and correct the template to what the VM shows.
